name: Callback bot
description: HTTP JSON relay with a sandboxed project panel, select/status/user settings, date/markdown fields, scoped callback tokens, and inbound complete/set_field actions.
author: SentientTD Studios

settings.label: Relay URL
settings.description: Public HTTPS URL of the sample relay (see relay/main.go) or any listener that accepts JSON. Private/LAN hosts are rejected.

settings.label: Triggers
settings.description: Events posted to the relay. JSON includes callback_token so the relay can comment or complete.

settings.label: Skip events I caused
settings.description: Do not post when you are the actor.

settings.label: Alert mode
settings.description: Stored in the JSON config object. The sample relay only comments on High priority when set to Urgent.

settings.label: Watch this status
settings.description: Optional kanban status id stored in config. The sample relay includes it in comments.

settings.label: Ping this member
settings.description: Optional project member id stored in config. The sample relay @-mentions them when commenting.

fields.label: Review by
fields.description: Date the callback bot (or inbound set_field) should treat as the review deadline.

fields.label: Bot notes
fields.description: Markdown the relay or inbound webhook can update via set_field.
